_doc: #1445 THE GitHub connect is ONE implementation: libs:git-ui GitConnect (libs:git-sync's GitEngine + GitCredentialStore, libs:git-repos' Auto Commit message). test-git-connect-one.sh fails when a file outside the shared git libs builds a GitHub credential (GitAuth.Https), clones with the engine (GitEngine.clone), uses JGit directly, or names the x-access-token user, unless the file is listed in `legacy` (an existing implementation not yet moved to GitConnect; the list may only shrink) . Cloud Me, Cloud Account and libs:account-ui are never allowed.

legacy.ac_cloud-drive/app/build.gradle: Cloud Drive's JGit packaging excludes, not a connect
legacy.ac_cloud-drive/app/src/main/java/com/die: Drive's first-run seed clone; moves to GitConnect with Drive's Sync > Git page
Drive's scheduled sync; moves to GitConnect
Drive's shared-store git; moves to GitConnect
libs:account's SSH key vault dependency, not a GitHub connect
legacy.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/account/src/ma: SSH key import into the vault, not a GitHub connect
legacy.ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/gh/src/main/ja: the gh engine itself (the sign-in whose token GitConnect receives)
